evals.prompt: Implement the NestWise 'record an expense' operation end to end: allocations sum to amountMinor, items belong to the caller's family and are not archived, admin/member only, client-supplied UUID made idempotent, period from txnDate, enteredBy = caller; POST /api/v1/transactions; unit tests.
evals.expected_output: A use case in packages/domain with gateways and fakes, a Drizzle adapter and composition factory in apps/web, and a thin route handler.
expectations: Business rules are enforced inside packages/domain, not in the route handler or the Server Component

No file under packages/domain imports a framework or I/O package (next, react, server-only, drizzle-orm, postgres, @supabase/*, @anthropic-ai/*) or a workspace outside package (packages/db, packages/api-contract)
Each operation is a *UseCase class with a single public execute() method, and there is no *Service class
Outbound dependencies are *Gateway interfaces declared in packages/domain that return domain types, not Drizzle row types
Domain unit tests use in-memory fakes and contain no vi.mock, vi.fn or vi.spyOn
Gateway adapters live in apps/web/src/adapters/<feature>/
Use cases are wired through make* factory functions in apps/web/src/composition/
Domain errors carry no HTTP status; mapping errors to HTTP statuses happens in apps/web
The familyId used for the operation comes from the authenticated actor/session, never from the request body
A repeated request with the same client transaction id returns the existing expense without creating a second one, and a test covers it
The core takes the current time from an injected Clock port (no new Date() or Date.now() in packages/domain)

evals.prompt: Implement 'confirm this month's pot deposit': amount > 0, admin/member only, one deposit per family-month, deposit + activity entry saved atomically; POST /api/v1/pot/deposits; Home Server Component shows the pot balance; unit tests.
evals.expected_output: A use case using a unit-of-work port for the atomic write, a query use case for the balance used by the Server Component, and a conflict error for a second deposit.
expectations: Business rules are enforced inside packages/domain, not in the route handler or the Server Component

No file under packages/domain imports a framework or I/O package (next, react, server-only, drizzle-orm, postgres, @supabase/*, @anthropic-ai/*) or a workspace outside package (packages/db, packages/api-contract)
